newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-LIONS PUT STANGER ON STANDBY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LIONS PUT STANGER ON STANDBY.

text.p: Scotland wing Tony Stanger has been put on standby for the British Lions, manager Fran Cotton said on Thursday.
Stanger, currently on tour in South Africa with Scotland, was contacted after centre Will Greenwood and wing Ieuan Evans were both injured.
Both players have been ruled out of the remainder of the tour, Greenwood with concussion and a dislocated shoulder while Evans has a groin strain.
"We will decide after Saturday's game how we use Tony," said Cotton.
Greenwood and Evans are both expected to be out of action for six to eight weeks.
